generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tender are invited as per Standard Tender bid document KW-4
Conditional Tenders will not be considered
All relevant documents as per the KW-4 need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in KPPP portal.
The Employer reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tender without assigning any reason.

The contractor has make his own arrangements for procurement of all the required materials and the materials so procured shall confirm to the relevant IS Specifications or Equivalent and obtain necessary quality certificate from authorized quality control.
All the documents required as per technical qualification criteria needed to be uploaded in Original or Attested by any official not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Notary
The Contractors should submit all the Documents as uploaded in Original an officer not below the rank of an Executive Engineer on or before opening of Technical Bid as Notified.
Name, address, and Mobile number, telex, Email and fax numbers of the contractor is to be provided

The contractor has to furnish Additional security deposit for unbalance tender as per clause 29.1 of ITT, to an amount equal to difference in contract price and amount put to tender, in addition to 5% performance guarantee (in any of the form prescribed) while concluding the Agreement
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) from Practicing Chartered Accountant is preferred in Annual Turn over

The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work and make themselves familiar with the local situation regarding the availability of the construction materials, workmen, land required for construction activities etc.
The tenderer shall also disclose if there are any bankruptcy proceedings against him

The Contractor shall provide work program as per Clause 25 under the chapter Time control of conditions of contract. The contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.

During the execution of the works, if any minor minerals are required, contractors have to abide by the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 (as amended up to date). As per the prevailing rules for any use of minor minerals the contractor has to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty and DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 ( as amended from time to time) will be deducted from the contractors bill at the time of payment

The Work Done Certificates shall be issued by the Executive Engineer (if work done in Karnataka State), otherwise it shall be issued/ counter signed by Superintending Engineer (if work is done in other states)
A copy of GST registration certificate should be uploaded

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract (service). GST payable by the contractor under this works contract will be paid to the contractor separately over and above the contractors bid amount. tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, Payment will be made/withdrawn accordingly. The increase if any in the GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the Authority.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2024-25 and prevailing GST (18 Percent of Amount put to Tender) amount is kept in form of lumpsum in sanctioned estimate. According to guidelines in Common SR Amount put to tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP Portal format has No Options to add GST separately. The item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly.
The period of completion is 09 (Nine months) including monsoon
If any of the dates mentioned in this tender happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Other details can be seen in the tender documents.
Omission and Typographical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.

The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Document KW-4. The Tenderer should adhere to all terms & conditions in the tender documents , Standard Specifications, and prevailing Government orders/ circulars.
The tenderer shall be eligible KPWD Registered contractor
Letter of Credit should be in prescribed format, if not, then the Bid is liable to be rejected
The bidder should enclose Site investigation certificate to show that the construction site visited by concerned bidder and there is no any obstruction for doing work
The bidder should verify the item wise works and should compulsorily attach program of work by self attestation
